rationale: The 5-min ATR of $0.05 is extremely compressed relative to the $14.14 price level (~35 bps), indicating momentum has fully stalled after the 27% gap-up—there is no directional edge in either continuation or reversal from this consolidation alone. The earnings catalyst is nearly 19 hours old and already fully priced into the gap, with the last five candles showing declining volume and a 10-cent range, suggesting neither buyers nor sellers are in control. Without a clear breakout above $14.45 or a breakdown below near-term support with volume confirmation, the tight bid-ask spread risk combined with low ATR makes finding a favorable risk/reward ratio impractical.
